Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the tourism development advisory committee.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the tourism development advisory committee; andamending RCW 43.330.095.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.330.095 and 1998 c 299 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tourism ((development advisory)) policy committee iscreated within the department. The committee shall have a total offifteen members. There shall be one member from each of the twolargest political caucuses in the house of representatives and senateappointed by the speaker of the house of representatives and thepresident of the senate, respectively. The remaining eleven membersshall be appointed by the ((director)) governor and shall represent thetravel industry. When making appointments, the ((director)) governorshall ensure to the greatest extent possible that the industryrepresentatives include all sectors of the travel industry inWashington state and are diverse with respect to region of the state,gender, and ethnicity. (2) The tourism ((development advisory)) policy committee shallmeet at such times designated by the director but not less than p. 1 HB 2885((twice)) four times per calendar year. The committee shall ((reviewand comment on)) develop the tourism development plan presented by thedepartment and advise the director ((concerning)) on tourism activitiesthe department should undertake. (((3) This section expires June 30, 2008.))
